summary: Custer County, ID log crib lookout on Challis NF, built 1934 and abandoned 1950; a state list still shows it standing, but no recent condition report was found.

facts.design: 20-foot log crib platform (Forest Lookouts page says log cabin)
facts.status_note: Only the Forest Fire Lookout Association Idaho list shows it standing; the history pages record abandonment in 1950 and describe nothing since, and no recent photo was found

access.note: Described as a hike-in on Challis National Forest land; no closure or permit rule found in the sources read, but the structure is abandoned

visit.trail_note: Hike-in per idahofirelookouts.com; no trail route or distance in the sources read

events.note: Built 1934. Sources disagree on the type: 20-foot log crib platform (sources 1 and 2) versus log cabin (source 3)
Abandoned in 1950 per all three history pages

evidence.supports: built 1934 as a 20-foot log crib platform (Idaho Fire Lookouts timeline)
built 1934 as a 20-foot log crib platform; abandoned 1950
evidence.quote: Constructed in 1934, this 20' log crib platform was abandoned in 1950.

evidence.supports: location: about 38 miles west-northwest of Challis, Challis National Forest
agency: Challis National Forest, Custer County, Idaho

evidence.quote: We don't yet have a documented staffing history for this lookout.

evidence.supports: 1934 structure recorded as a log cabin, credited to Kresek
Forest Fire Lookout Association Idaho list shows it standing, type log crib
evidence.quote: Sliderock Ridge Custer 44.65860 -114.95296 Log Crib Standing

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Two sources say 20-foot log crib platform and one says log cabin. The story reports both and does not choose between them.

The brief says standing. Only the Forest Fire Lookout Association list shows standing; the history pages record abandonment in 1950 and say nothing about today. The story presents standing as unconfirmed.

notes_for_editor: Standing rests on a single list entry; no photo or condition report was found. The brief's 'standing' is kept in facts with a status_note. Access is recorded as public on the strength of 'Hike-In' alone; no closure or permit page was checked. Only four sources were read. Elevation of 9121 ft (idahofirelookouts.com) was not used in the story. Idahofirelookouts 'Abandoned' appears to describe use, not the structure.
